ADDED TO CALENDAR FOR THE COURT TO ADDRESS SERVICE AND PROOF OF SERVICE ISSUES. HEARING SET FOR FEB-24-2026 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF SYLVIA RICHARDSON IS NOT PRESENT. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT BAY AREA TOLL AUTHORITY IS PRESENT FOR FASTRACK REPRESENTED BY MS. ALEXIS. UPON EXAMINATION OF THE PROOF OF SERVICE, IT INDICATED THAT THE SERVICE DATE OF THE CLAIM WAS JAN-15-2026 WITH A HEARING DATE SET FOR APR-28-2026. THE PLAINTIFF'S CASE WAS RESET TO APR-28-2026 ON FEB-17-2026. THEREFORE, THE COURT DISMISSES THE PLAINTIFF'S CASE WITHOUT PREJUDICE. JUDGE:JOSH M. FREDRICKS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF SYLVIA RICHARDSON. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT FASTRACK. THIS MATTER WAS PREVIOUSLY DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE ON FEB-24-26. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: BRADEN WOODS; CLERK: N.WEBB. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
